description: This Java source file defines Swagger API documentation classes for journal entries in the Fineract accounting module, including response/request schemas and nested data classes.

classes.name: JournalEntriesApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger API schemas for journal entry responses and requests.

classes.name: PostJournalEntriesResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after posting journal entries, including officeId and transactionId.

classes.name: PostJournalEntriesTransactionIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for request to associate a transaction ID with an office.

classes.name: PostJournalEntriesTransactionIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for response confirming transaction ID association with an office.

classes.name: CurrencyItem
classes.description: Schema representing currency details such as code, name, symbol, and formatting.

classes.name: EnumOptionType
classes.description: Schema for enumerated options like account types or transaction types.

classes.name: JournalEntryTransactionItem
classes.description: Represents individual journal entry transaction items with nested payment and transaction details.

classes.name: PaymentDetailData
classes.description: Details of payment method used in a transaction, including account info and routing.

classes.name: TransactionDetails
classes.description: Additional details about a transaction, including type, notes, and payment info.

classes.name: GetJournalEntriesTransactionIdResponse
classes.description: Response schema for retrieving journal entries by transaction ID, including total records and list of items.
